answer: The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the oasis of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. A zenith of per-task receipts records who did what, and the tundra of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short.
